title: The Same Words
who: watch hand at the hab's traffic counter
want: Confirm or clear a distress call that repeats the same words in the same pitch, heard near the hab's inner lane.
at_stake: Your crew answers a call that is not what it claims, or ignores one that is, and the watch hand logs which.
complication: The voice repeats the same words in the same pitch when shouted at. (complications.md, distress call 1)

approaches.label: Shout a challenge down the channel
Send a probe up the lane
Ask what the hab logged last cycle
approaches.npc_reaction: opens a ledger older than himself

Shout a challenge down the channel.clean: the hab's hands remember your crew testing the call before acting
Shout a challenge down the channel.cost: the watch hand logs the shouting and your crew pays the counter for the lane time spent
Shout a challenge down the channel.fail: your crew pays for the lane time wasted on the repeat

Send a probe up the lane.clean: the hab pays your crew for clearing the lane
Send a probe up the lane.cost: a probe is lost in the lane and your crew pays for it
Send a probe up the lane.fail: the probe finds nothing and your crew pays the watch hand for the lost lane time

Ask what the hab logged last cycle.clean: the watch hand pays your crew's goodwill back with a fee for the older pages read aloud
Ask what the hab logged last cycle.cost: your crew pays the clerk for the older pages
Ask what the hab logged last cycle.fail: your crew pays the clerk for a log with a gap
